newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up on panic short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up on panic short-covering.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended sharply up on Thursday on panic short-covering before the Friday-Saturday weekend and are likely to open up on Sunday, dealers said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index ended 31.99 points, or 2.40 percent, up at 1,362.94 amid 124 losers and 104 gainers. Turnover rose to 18 million shares from Tuesday's 21 million. "The stocks, which shedded most in the last few sessions, recovered on short-covering with handsome gains in PTCL, HUBCO and Fauji Fertilizer," dealer Ali Raza said.
